overview_description.description:
Zus Health helps a new wave of healthcare builders create technologies and services without the usual blockers. Zus Health aims to bring forth a better health reality by empowering an inspired new wave of healthcare builders to create digital technologies and services that are cheaper, easier to customize, and far more intimate.

Zus Health was established in 2020 in Watertown, Massachusetts by Jonathan Bush.

about_short_description.short_description: Zus Health helps a new wave of healthcare builders to create technologies and services without the usual blockers.

product.name: Zus Aggregated Profile (ZAP)
product.description: A unified, shareable patient profile that consolidates clinical history from multiple sources for use by care teams at the point of care.

product.name: Zus Platform (Zus Grid)
product.description: A shared health data platform that connects healthcare data sources, creates common patient records, and delivers normalized clinical information for care and software workflows.

product.name: Zus API & Components
product.description: API-driven tools and embedded components for retrieving, analyzing, updating, and displaying normalized patient data within healthcare applications and workflows.

product.name: Zus App
product.description: A standalone browser application that gives care teams access to consolidated patient history and related clinical data without requiring a deep EHR integration.

product.name: EHR & SaaS Integrations
product.description: Direct and embedded integrations that place Zus patient history and profile data inside supported EHR and healthcare software platforms.
